newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George ends honeymoon home rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George ends honeymoon home rates.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it would end its "honeymoon" rates for new home loan customers and extend its customer Loyalty programme to include immediate family members of long-term St George customers.
St George said its Loyalty programme extends the interest rate discount on the standard variable home loan rate to the immediate family of existing customers.
The loyalty rate being offered is a reduction of 0.35 percent off the owner-occupied standard variable rate, at 8.4 percent from January 1.

St George retail bank head, Neil Berkett, said in a staetment honeymoon rates, traditionally used by banks to generate new customers, had been axed by St George as part of its plan to reward long-term loyal customers.
